code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] != bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]; edge=False
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                if y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1: edge=True
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and g[yy][xx]==bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            if not edge:
                fill=2 if len(cells)%2==0 else 7
                for y,x in cells: g[y][x]=fill
    return g
'''
